description: This PHP source file defines a class for allocating ad impressions to zones within an ad server system, handling over-subscription and impression scaling, and saving impression allocations to a database.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Priority_AdServer_Task_AllocateZoneImpressions
classes.description: A class responsible for allocating ad impressions to zones, managing over-subscription, and persisting allocations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parent class and setting up the table object.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method executing the impression allocation process, including setting forecasts, campaigns, associations, allocations, and saving results.

methods.name: _setZoneForecasts
methods.description: Sets available forecast impressions per zone, defaulting inactive zones to a minimum forecast.

methods.name: _setCampaigns
methods.description: Retrieves all active campaigns, sets their ads, and fetches required impressions.

methods.name: _getAllCampaigns
methods.description: Fetches all campaigns with priority >= 1 and status 'running' from the database.

methods.name: _setRequiredImpressions
methods.description: Fetches and assigns required impressions for a list of ads.

methods.name: _setAdZoneAssociations
methods.description: Retrieves ad-zone linkages for campaigns and ads.

methods.name: _allocateRequiredImpressions
methods.description: Allocates impressions to ad-zone pairs based on forecast volumes.

methods.name: _calculateOverSubscribedZoneInformation
methods.description: Determines if zones are over-subscribed and calculates adjustment factors for impression scaling.

methods.name: _allocateRequestedImpressions
methods.description: Scales requested impressions in over-subscribed zones and finalizes allocations.
